tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The logo wordmark's navy. Same value as text-primary and action-primary in light. Use for brand moments that must stay navy in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: The dot on the logo's i. Logo, cover and brand moments only. 3.0:1 on white: never text, never a meaningful UI mark (use accent).

tokens.name: logo-ground
tokens.usage: The light ground the navy logo sits on in both themes. There is no reversed logo yet, so on dark screens place it on a logo-ground plate.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background: warm paper in light, deep navy night in dark. Default ground for text-primary, text-secondary and text-tertiary.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, sticky bars, tab bar.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Section bands on hub screens, input wells, skeletons, +N avatar, reaction pills. Never put text-tertiary on it.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating search pill, quick-action circles, popovers.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers, card outlines in dark mode, tab-row underline.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, chips, input underlines, dashed empty-state border, sheet grabber.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Navy ink: titles and body on canvas, surface and sunken (15.8:1 light). Also the 'new' activity dot.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, eyebrows, captions on canvas, surface and sunken (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on canvas or surface only (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: text-on-image
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on photo scrims and glass chips.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: The ink pill in navy: primary buttons, floating pills, toasts, selected date circles, toggle on-state. Inverts to a paper pill in dark.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of the ink pill.

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tripami orange, deepened from brand-orange to pass AA as text. State only: active tab indicator, selected chip, your vote, now, deadlines, links, the needs-you dot. At most 5% of a layout; never a button fill. 5.3:1 on canvas, 4.9:1 on sunken (light); 6.9:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed links and selected controls.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, the 'now' itinerary row, your reaction pill. accent text on it passes AA (5.0:1 light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyph on an accent fill (checkmarks only).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Settled up, confirmed, online presence dot. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: You owe. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Crimson, so it never reads as the orange accent. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Navy glass for chips and icon buttons on photos, with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: scrim-end
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the photo scrim (transparent at 40% → scrim-end at 100%). Text on photos sits bottom-left on it.

tokens.name: member-lagoon
tokens.usage: Traveler identity color #1 in join order (trip creator). Avatar fill with white initials (AA), avatar ring, vote and payer dots, 'added by'. None is near brand-orange. Never a button or background.

tokens.name: member-sky
tokens.usage: Traveler identity color #2 in join order. Avatar fill with white initials (AA), avatar ring, vote and payer dots, 'added by'. None is near brand-orange. Never a button or background.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Trip names on covers and heroes, the Memories title.

styles.name: diary-heading
styles.usage: Day headings in the itinerary and Memories.

styles.name: diary-body
styles.usage: Journal entries and notes written by travelers.
styles.sample: We missed the last tram and walked home through Alfama.

styles.name: diary-quote
styles.sample: Best pastel de nata of the trip.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Screen large titles. Regular weight, never bold.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet titles, empty-state titles.
styles.sample: Where should we eat on Friday?

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary row text, descriptions, underline tabs.
styles.sample: Add a place and the group can vote on it.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, attribution lines, glass chips.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels and form labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab bar labels, chip counts, avatar initials at 24–32px.

styles.name: button-small
styles.usage: Small pill buttons (40px), chips, tertiary links.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Screen side margin is space-6 (24px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Stacked metadata lines; avatar overlap (−8px).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chips; between carousel cards; eyebrow to content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section title to content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side margin; text inset on photos.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between unrelated sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a large title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state top padding on a full screen.

radius.note: Use continuous (superellipse) corners where the platform allows.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in rows, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Glass chips on photos, input wells, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, selectable option cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Trip cover cards, empty-state container.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of sheets and of the hub surface rising over a hero photo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search, floating pills.

tokens.name: size-hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-button-large
tokens.usage: Large pill button height.

tokens.name: size-button-small
tokens.usage: Small pill button height.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height.

tokens.name: size-quick-action
tokens.usage: Quick-action circle.

tokens.name: size-row-min
tokens.usage: Single-line list row minimum height (72px two-line).

shadow.note: Soft, wide, ink-tinted. In dark mode cards use a hairline instead.
